name: watchface.dual_time.selected_index
evidence: The dual-time page creates a root and stores it in 0x20119740 before building the list. Both row creation and update register event 7 with the row index as user data. The shared callback reads that data, uses indices 0 through 42 (larger unsigned values become 0), stores the chosen index, persists it under watchface_dual_time and publishes the chosen table entry. The destroy callback clears the page root.
scope: dual-time option selection callback while the dual-time page root is active
limitations: Indices refer to firmware order, not a stable timezone identifier; module changes affect the selected/persisted option. The common getter requires system-wide quiescence during publication and rollback. Static analysis only.
registration_evidence: The create and update row paths register the same event-7 callback with the timezone index as user data. The create path ignores the descriptor; the update function returns it to its caller.
